package com.acme.shipping.label;

/**
 * Adapter for the pre-2020 carrier API. Scheduled for removal once LEGACY volume is zero.
 */
public class LegacyCarrierAdapter {

    public String toLegacyServiceCode(final Carrier carrier) {
        return "LG/" + carrier.name().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
    }
}
